div.div: Dispatch, retry, heartbeat timeouts, attempt fencing and cancellation are Temporal's own. The scheduler decides the pool queue, the memory class and the activity timeouts; Temporal holds the backlog and the scheduler does not move messages. Option B, the fallback only if Temporal later fails a real need: ready tasks go to RabbitMQ class queues, the scheduler leases them to workers over HTTP long-poll, backed by a Postgres lease ledger with fencing.
